description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or project scope): create, change, pause, resume, rotate the secret of or revoke a durable hook (POST /api/v1/hooks, PATCH /api/v1/hooks/:id, DELETE /api/v1/hooks/:id) as events.hook@1. The signing secret is shown once in the create or rotate answer and stored by Events; it is never in a read, a delivery record, an event or an audit entry. The delivery endpoint is fixed to the hook's own share host, so a hook cannot be pointed at another host.
